title: 连接 Dify
description: 填写你的 Dify 地址和访问令牌。凭证仅保存在本机的 WorkBuddy 中。
description_en: Enter your Dify host and an access token. They are stored only on this computer, in WorkBuddy.

fields.label: Dify 地址
fields.description: 只填域名，不要带 https:// 和路径。
fields.description_en: The host name only, without https:// or a path.

fields.label: 访问令牌
fields.description: 建议使用个人访问令牌。工作区访问令牌只能查找和运行应用，不能管理插件、模型和工具凭据，也不能回复运行中的人工输入表单。
fields.description_en: A personal access token is recommended. A workspace access token can only find and run apps: it cannot manage plugins, models or tool credentials, or answer a human-input form in a paused run.
